Jantar Mantar Protest Site Denotified, Activists Condemn Move

The designated protest site at Delhi's Jantar Mantar has been denotified, drawing condemnation from the Students' Federation of India (SFI) and the Democratic Youth Federation of India (DYFI). The move echoes historical debates around designated protest areas, drawing parallels with London's Hyde Park.
